items.title: Cybersecurity and Safe Digital Collaboration: Introduction

source_refs.note: Chapter opening with Fig 9.1 (PDF 122). The learning outcomes are not reproduced; the cybersecurity definition is from the chapter summary.

blocks.text: This chapter explores how technology supports safe, secure and responsible participation in the digital world. It covers online safety, cybersecurity, data protection, privacy settings and secure collaboration on modern platforms; digital entrepreneurship, innovation and the skills to spot business opportunities; and the ethical, legal, social and environmental sides of computing, including intellectual property, data privacy, cybersecurity laws and sustainable computing. It also stresses teamwork, accessibility, digital communication and responsible use of technology in personal, educational and professional life (Fig 9.1).

blocks.title: Cybersecurity
blocks.text: Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting computers, networks, data and online accounts from unauthorised access, misuse, damage or cyberattacks.
